summary: A Depth subscription whose book comes before the scrip's first quote: the book goes out alone, and once the first symbol-feed snapshot comes it goes again with the quote (audit P-07).

deviations.reason: The web's Fyers adapter stamps timestamp with int(time.time()), epoch seconds; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), as the desktop sends them.
The web's Fyers frames carry the broker's exchange token; the desktop's frames do not. Lane wire to decide whether the carrier passes broker tokens.
The web's Fyers frames say whether the message was a snapshot or a live update; the desktop's do not (a web-internal key a client can read). Lane wire to decide.
A depth frame keeps ltp, which the SDK's Depth callback reads: 0 before the instrument's first quote; the web's Fyers depth before the first quote has no ltp (CLAUDE.md, the compatibility contract).

The web's Fyers quote carries the best bid and ask with sizes; A key the web sends from some mode up is sent in that mode and every mode above it, so a script reading it on the richer frame meets no KeyError (feed/dialect/names.rs rules, docs/port/market-data-frames.md).

The desktop also sends the canonical price_change / price_change_percent on a Fyers instrument, whose adapter names the change change / change_percent / percent_change only (lead ruling: non-docs change keys follow the adapter). The dialect has no switch that drops the canonical keys and keeps the adapter's names (instrument_change gates both): lane wire.
